Indian national jailed in Paris for leading child abuse ring

Rohan Rane, an Indian national, has been sentenced to 20 years in prison by a Paris court for leading an online child abuse ring. The court found him guilty of offenses including extortion, torture, and barbarity against victims. The ring operated globally, utilizing platforms like Discord, and involved the sharing of sadistic videos. One report described the group as a sadist neo-Nazi cult that tortured girls, while another mentioned a global monkey torture network, though the primary focus of the conviction was child abuse.
